desc:
🍔 Welcome to McDonald’s Restaurant! 🍟

Join us for a fun and realistic McDonald’s experience on Roblox! Serve customers, prepare food, and become part of our friendly team.

⭐ What We Offer:

* Active and friendly staff
* Fun restaurant roleplays
* Great customer service
* A welcoming community
* FREE TO JOIN — NO TRAINING REQUIRED! 🎉

👨‍🍳 Roles Available:

* Cashier
* Cook
* Drive-Thru Worker
* Shift Manager
* Restaurant Manager

Everyone is welcome! No training, no hassle — just join, pick a role, and get started!

🍟 Your Restaurant. Your Team. Your Experience! 🍔
